name: Pullman Singapore Hill Street
short_description: A 350-room 5-star Pullman that opened in October 2023 on Hill Street in Singapore's Civic District, steps from City Hall MRT and Clarke Quay.
ai_summary: Pullman Singapore Hill Street opened on 1 October 2023 on Hill Street in Singapore's Civic District, a five-minute walk from City Hall MRT with direct underground access, and close to Fort Canning Park and Clarke Quay. The 350-room hotel leans into a railway-junction design theme referencing the Pullman brand's 19th-century train heritage, with three dining and drinking concepts -- Madison's, Japanese izakaya MOGA, and rooftop bar El Chido -- plus two outdoor pools including a rooftop infinity pool. Guest reviews are strongly positive on the central location, fresh post-opening condition, and one of the larger hotel gyms in Singapore, with more mixed notes on weak shower pressure, air-conditioning that struggles to cool rooms fully, and a pricey breakfast at Madison's.

pros: 350 rooms opened October 2023, a five-minute walk (with underground access) to City Hall MRT
Railway-junction design theme nodding to the Pullman brand's train heritage, blended with contemporary interiors
Two outdoor pools, including a rooftop infinity pool at El Chido with Marina Bay skyline views
One of the larger hotel gyms in Singapore, per guest reviews, with 24-hour access
Three distinct dining concepts on-site: American comfort food at Madison's, Japanese izakaya MOGA, and rooftop bar El Chido
cons: Guests report weak shower water pressure and air-conditioning that struggles to hit set temperatures in some rooms
Breakfast at Madison's is called overpriced by multiple reviewers relative to nearby neighborhood options
research_highlights: A February 2024 Her World review called the hotel a 'one-stop luxury' standout among Singapore's new openings, highlighting the Executive Room's Marina Bay views and one of the city's biggest hotel gyms
A November 2025 blog review reconfirmed the central City Hall MRT location as a standout strength while flagging shower pressure, aircon, and pricey breakfast as recurring gripes
Room count (350) and the October 2023 opening date are confirmed consistently across the official site and independent listings
research_watchouts: Reviews span the hotel's first two years open, so very recent guest experience post-2025 wasn't independently re-verified beyond the November 2025 blog piece
No independent aggregate rating (TripAdvisor-style score) was pulled into this file beyond individual review summaries

faqs.question: How far is Pullman Singapore Hill Street from City Hall MRT station?
faqs.answer: About a 5-minute walk, with a direct underground walkway connection, putting the hotel within easy reach of Marina Bay, the Civic District, Clarke Quay and Fort Canning Park without needing a taxi. It's one of the more centrally located 5-star hotels to open in Singapore in recent years.

faqs.question: When did Pullman Singapore Hill Street open?
faqs.answer: It officially opened on 1 October 2023 with 350 rooms and suites across ten levels. The property is designed around a railway-junction theme referencing the Pullman brand's 19th-century luxury train heritage, paired with contemporary interiors and three on-site dining and drinking venues.
